'''{{PAGENAME}}''' is a [[Quests|Quest]] in ''[[Escape from Tarkov]]''.

==Dialogue==
{{quote|The bum from Polikhim? What am I, the bloody king of every stray in Tarkov now?! Alright, I know who you're talking about, same as everyone else who's lived here. He wasn't a bad bloke, but he lost the plot when all this mess kicked off. You're looking for him, are you? I can help you out, but not out of the goodness of my heart. The Scavs have been getting under my feet lately, making things difficult. Go give them a proper scare, and then I'll tell you what I know. Here's the list of places that need clearing.}}

==Objectives==
* Eliminate 25 [[Scavs]] on [[Interchange]], [[Ground Zero]] or [[Woods]]

==Rewards==
* +3,000 [[EXP]]
* [[Skier]] Rep <font color="green">'''+0.1'''</font>
* 450 Euros
** 473 Euros with [[Hideout#Modules|Intelligence Center]] Level 1

{{quote|Your bum was staying by the train tracks, in a wagon near the boiler building. There's a bunker nearby as well, right by the tracks. My lads used to see him in that carriage all the time.}}
